metric_definitions.defects_caught: Count of defect fixtures with a finding in the expected class.
metric_definitions.false_positives_per_clean_pr: Total findings on the clean fixtures divided by the number of clean fixtures.
metric_definitions.time_to_verdict_seconds: Median elapsed seconds per fixture from sending the review request through parsing the verdict.

pre_epic.basis: First parent of #1769, the earliest epic child merge identified in local history.
